lines: State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there,
sanskrit_cite: avasthāyugalaṃ cātra kāryakartṛtvaśabditam | kāryatā kṣayiṇī tatra kartṛtvam punar akṣayam

lines: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost outright here;
'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise maintain.
sanskrit_cite: kāryonmukhaḥ prayatno yaḥ kevalaṃ so 'tra lupyate | tasmin lupte vilupto 'smīty abudhaḥ pratipadyate

lines: But who inward-facing is, the seat of knowing-all;
his loss can never be, from perceiving no other at all.
sanskrit_cite: na tu yo 'ntarmukho bhāvah sarvajñātvaguṇāspadam | tasya lopaḥ kadācit syād anyasyānupalambhanāt

lines: His perception ever, in three states unfailing;
ever the fully awake's — but the other's, at beginning and end.
sanskrit_cite: tasyopalabdhiḥ satataṃ tripadāvyabhicāriṇī | nityaṃ syāt suprabuddhasya tadādyante parasya tu

lines: Whose form is knowing and knowable, by supreme power yoked;
in two states the pervader shines — elsewhere, consciousness-made.
sanskrit_cite: jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇyā śaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | padadvaye vibhur bhāti tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ

lines: Spanda-flows from qualities, grounded in common spanda's core;
self-got self-gainers ever be — the unopposed knower's evermore.
sanskrit_cite: guṇādispandaniḥṣyandāḥ sāmānyaspandasaṃśrayāt | labdhātmalābhaḥ satataṃ syur jñasyāparipanthinaḥ
